clue.text: As Miss Fairfax to Miss Bates, agreeable to embrace Emma initially

clue.text: Kerouac, say, to attend prison we hear

clue.text: Sleep mostly disturbed involving a tense time, here perhaps?

clue.text: It features the maid Ko-ko half fancied

clue.text: We both — over the implications of that (Nevil Shute, No Highway)

clue.text: Carpenter getting a woman into bed? Just the reverse!

clue.text: Where in Kent to find a quiet Berkshire mistress?
